title: Live verification result
description: The machine-readable tail of a drive-verifier smoke pass. Consumed by drive-handback.sh when it writes the hand-back block.

verdict.description: PASS only when every flow passed with artifacts. UNVERIFIED when the harness could not be reached (no dev server, sign-in blocked) — that is an honest outcome, not a failure. FAIL on any defect.

flows.description: One entry per flow walked. A PASS with an empty evidence[] is discarded by the engine and recorded as UNVERIFIED.

evidence.description: Screenshot paths, persisted-state query output, console/network excerpts — artifacts this run produced.

screenshots.description: Every screenshot path produced, so the hand-back can cite them.

db_asserts.description: One entry per write action verified against persisted state. A 200 with nothing persisted is a defect, not a pass.
